title: Theory of Change: Preventing AfD Harm via Activism + NARM Therapy

nodes.text: Therapists skilled in NeuroAffective Relational Model who can hold a non-shaming container for people with heavy projection patterns.
nodes.title: NARM-trained practitioners willing to work with far-right figures

connections.evidence: NARM practitioner network exists but few are politically willing
connections.assumptions: Enough practitioners exist and are willing to engage ethically fraught clients

nodes.text: People able to deliberately trigger a projecting figure AND stay in relationship to offer a bridge afterwards (your Aldi-conversation pattern).
nodes.title: Activists trained in 'confront + support' method

connections.evidence: Rare skill combo; most activists only do confrontation
connections.assumptions: The skill is teachable; activists willing to also offer support

nodes.text: Resources to run small-scale experiments (e.g. ecstatic dance test case) before scaling to political targets.
nodes.title: Small-scale test pilots e.g. ecstatic dance scene)

connections.assumptions: Funders see value in testing mechanism on non-political cases first

nodes.text: People trusted by AfD-adjacent networks who can broker contact (Mehr Demokratie / Braver Angels DE have shown this is possible).
nodes.title: Intermediary access brokers

connections.evidence: Access brokers are the single hardest input to secure for AfD leader engagement
connections.assumptions: Brokers remain willing to broker contact for a confrontational purpose; AfD figures don't blanket-refuse once brokered

connections.evidence: Same brokers can likely facilitate the follow-on therapeutic offer
connections.assumptions: The same relational channel used for confrontation can be used to deliver the support offer; leaders don't refuse support purely because activists accessed them

nodes.text: Direct, personal challenge that destabilises the leader's defensive structure — not public shaming, but intimate confrontation that lands.
nodes.title: Triggering personal confrontations with AfD leaders

connections.evidence: Triggering is easy; the question is whether it opens or closes the leader
connections.assumptions: Confrontation is intimate/relational (not public shaming, which entrenches); leader can't easily discharge discomfort by attacking/dismissing the activist

nodes.text: Immediate NARM-informed holding of the triggered material — the 'offer' half of the Aldi-pattern.
nodes.title: Therapeutic support offered post-trigger

connections.evidence: NARM attunement is a replicable clinical skill
connections.assumptions: NARM-style attunement is possible across political divides without therapist's political reactions leaking; leader perceives the attunement as genuine care rather than strategic manipulation

connections.evidence: Trust-building usually requires repeated contact; harder with high-defence populations
connections.assumptions: Trust can build in limited contact (not years of therapy); no early shame-rupture breaks the container; leader has some capacity for internal observation

nodes.text: Low-stakes test cases where projecting actors harm a community but face no incentives to change — proving ground for the mechanism.
nodes.title: Preliminary evidence for critical assumptions

connections.evidence: No prior evidence yet — this IS the experiment; transfer across populations is the key uncertainty
connections.assumptions: Methods calibrated on non-political cases (ecstatic dance / Aldi-type) actually transfer to political actors

nodes.text: The therapeutic contact lands as genuine attunement — leaders experience being met in their anger/fear without judgement or political push-back.
nodes.title: AfD leaders feel heard, validated, and seen in their emotions

connections.evidence: NARM clinical outcomes support attunement → defence softening; untested with political actors
connections.assumptions: Feeling heard is a necessary precondition for defensive structures to soften; validation doesn't accidentally reinforce the projection itself

nodes.text: After one or more contained experiences, leaders develop a felt sense that engaging their rage/fear/shame won't destroy them or expose them socially.
nodes.title: AfD leaders build trust that difficult emotions can be felt safely

connections.evidence: Trust-building in therapeutic alliance is well-documented; speed with resistant populations is slower
connections.assumptions: Trust in the container generalises to willingness to meet very old pain; leader's attachment system is accessible (not fully foreclosed)

nodes.text: Confrontation generates a motivational charge: the status quo feels less tolerable than engaging the therapeutic offer.
nodes.title: AfD leaders feel sufficient discomfort/pressure to engage with their emotional material

connections.evidence: Motivational interviewing shows discomfort → engagement at modest rates; backfire common with hardened identities
connections.assumptions: Discomfort motivates deeper engagement rather than retreat into harder defences; pressure doesn't overwhelm the container's holding capacity

nodes.text: The core NARM move: rage/distrust/betrayal felt toward Greens, media, refugees is recognised as material from early relational wounding, and the emotion completes rather than discharges onto the projected target.
nodes.title: AfD leaders locate anger/fear in psychological parents and metabolise the projection

connections.evidence: Clinical NARM shows metabolisation is possible; political translation is the untested leap
connections.assumptions: Psychological insight actually translates to political-identity change; leader's social/economic position doesn't force maintaining the stance regardless of inner shift; metabolisation is durable enough to withstand party pressure to re-radicalise

nodes.text: Visible, public shift: fewer scapegoating statements, moderation of anti-migrant rhetoric, abstentions or no-votes on harmful policies.
nodes.title: AfD leaders soften their public positioning on harmful policies

connections.evidence: Party machines typically eject deviants rather than follow them; some historical cases of partial moderation exist
connections.assumptions: Enough leaders shift simultaneously to move party line, OR softening influences discourse even without full capture; softening is public and credible, not just private shift

nodes.text: Concrete legislative / rhetorical outcomes: fewer anti-migrant policies passed, less dehumanising discourse in parliament.
nodes.title: Harmful AfD policies based on scapegoating prevented or softened

connections.evidence: Policy → wellbeing link well-established for migrant populations
connections.assumptions: Policy change actually translates to lived experience change

nodes.text: Reduced suffering for refugees/minorities who would otherwise face scapegoating-based harm; also reduced suffering for people previously trapped in projection patterns.
nodes.title: Wellbeing improved for targeted groups AND formerly-projecting individuals
